examined: rated difficulty bands and zero-weight exclusion
SHA256 seeded uniform selection within active band
legacy unconfigured policy selects lowest fresh ID
result: Configured easy-band fixtures retain both decisions with all five new records, and after removing the first new record. Selection changes membership and frequency, not question content. Legacy first-ID behavior was reproduced and supplies no generator-level diversity guarantee.
limitations: No live learner histories, configured policy weights or future assigned entity IDs supplied. Fixture IDs explicitly stand for unpublished records.
A history can remove every member of an outcome; arbitrary histories cannot be guaranteed balanced by a generator. This is not a prediction of live delivery.
